motion: the plunger moves up and down and water splashes onto the tiles
the rubber rim compresses and seals against the surface
the plunger sits on the sink and water surrounds its rim
the rubber compresses and springs back
the plunger tilts in and settles flat over the opening
the plunger pumps in a steady rhythm and water pulses
the cable disappears into the drain as the handle turns
the plunger pumps over the drain and water ripples
